sources.title: moonshotai/Kimi-K3.1-Pro · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Post-trained from Kimi K3 with large-scale joint reinforcement learning across hundreds of downstream domains, it is the first model in the K3.1 series. With a 1-million-token context window, Kimi K3.1 Pro delivers substantial improvements in coding, 3D creation, financial research, factual accuracy, and other agentic capabilities. 2. Model Summary

sources.title: Kimi K3.1 Pro Tech Blog: Advancing Open Intelligence
sources.snippet: Introducing Kimi K3.1 Pro, our most capable 3T-class open-weight model with 1M-token context and major advances in coding, 3D modeling, and financial research.
